# 金籙解壇儀

**ID:** KR5b0175
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0175

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The ninth of the Dù Guāngtíng **Jīnlù** 金籙 cycle ([KR5b0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0167)–[KR5b0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0181)); the *jiětán yí* 解壇儀 ("altar-dismissal liturgy") closes the multi-day *Jīnlù* rite by formally dissolving the ritual demarcation of the altar space. The text is transmitted in a single fascicle (三儀同卷軆五, *Tǐ* 5) together with [KR5b0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0176) *shèjiào yí* and [KR5b0177](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0177) *fàngshēng yí* — the offering, the release-of-life, and the altar-dismissal — which together close the rite.

**Abstract**

Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 996, entry by John Lagerwey). The *jiětán* sequence: *xièzhēn* 謝真 (thanks to the descended deities); formal *sòngshèng* 送聖 dismissal; dispersal of the altar implements; lifting of the *jiéjiè* spatial boundary; and the *bǔ* 卜 divination to verify the rite's success. The procedure was already articulated in the Six Dynasties Lingbao *zhāi* tradition but receives its standard articulation here in the Dù Guāngtíng synthesis.
